assertions.claim: Two speed-dating studies had participants fill 100+ mate-choice questionnaire items before meeting
assertions.cn_span: 两场闪电约会研究让人在见面前填了 100 多项择偶问卷

assertions.claim: Models could predict 'generally easy to like' and 'generally popular' but not the spark between two specific people
assertions.cn_span: 结果只能算出「这个人普遍容易喜欢别人」和「这个人普遍受欢迎」，唯独算不出「这两个具体的人之间来不来电」

assertions.claim: Even self-stated ideal-partner preferences (looks vs financial prospects) did not predict in-person interest in a specific person
assertions.cn_span: 连人自己说的理想型（看重外貌还是看重经济前景），也预测不了他现场对某个人的兴趣

assertions.claim: Compatibility is only known upon meeting, so time spent meeting several people beats betting on one
assertions.cn_span: 合不合得来只有见了面才知道，所以把时间花在多认识几个人上，比押在一个人身上划算

assertions.claim: Random forest predicted general likability (4%-18% of variance) and general popularity (7%-27%)
assertions.cn_span: 随机森林模型能预测「一个人整体上有多容易喜欢别人」（4%–18% 的方差）和「一个人整体上有多受欢迎」（7%–27%）

assertions.claim: Samples are European/American students; Chinese marriage market differs, transfer conclusions with a discount
assertions.cn_span: 都是欧美大学生样本，中国的婚恋市场结构不同，结论迁移要打折
